label: GO step after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), and almost exclusively when the previous trial was unrewarded (99.7% of activation mass has prev_reward == 0; ~0 after rewards). Within GO-after-loss it is active on only ~28% of steps, so precision is low: it is a gated subset of post-loss GO steps. Magnitude/rate is higher after consecutive losses (two losses in a row: precision 0.44, holding 57% of mass on 28% of predicted steps), when value is mid-high (7.5-8.1; zero above 8.1), earlier in the episode (rate falls from 6% in trials 0-9 to 0.4% in 90-99), shortly after a reversal (since_rev 1-4), when the upcoming choice is a switch or not the good action, and after a previous a2 choice. Also ~94% active on the rare GO steps carrying a fixation-break penalty input (in_rew = -1), which hold 10% of mass. Refinements (value > 7.54, ep_trial < 60) raise F1 only to ~0.53, so the simple observed predicate is recorded; it uses only observed variables.
